Fighting Simulator 2 in 1 - Flying Warri.name: Fighting Simulator: 2 in 1 Flying Warriors
Fighting Simulator 2 in 1 - Flying Warri.summary: A port of Hiryuu no Ken Gaiden, a spin-off of the Flying Dragon series. It is a fighting game in the Flying Warriors series, using the westernized characters in place the of the ones from Hiryuu no Ken Gaiden. Includes a beat-'em-up mode.
